headline: Switch off the web-shop QA environment at night and at weekends, except the last Tuesday?
priceBasis: At the rates on your bill
waiting: Keeping things as they are forgoes about €23 a day, at the rates on your bill.
why: Six people use it, 07:45 to 18:30 on weekdays only (11 weeks of access records). I prefer this to option C, which saves more but needs about two days of engineering.
checked: 11 weeks of access records show nothing outside those hours except the last Tuesday of the month. Strongest doubt: a job on that night. You told me one runs, so the schedule leaves it on.

options.label: Switch off at weekends only
options.effect: Saves about €320 a month, range €280 to €360, Expected, at the rates on your bill. Undo in minutes.

options.label: Create it for each test run instead
options.effect: Saves about €940 a month, range €820 to €1,060, Expected, at the rates on your bill. About two days of engineering.

details.reversibility: switch it back on in minutes, any time
